decisions.reason: The ID Vault feature is a low-cost addition to the existing platform with unresolved but promising prospects in secure digital identity, so the option to keep it alive is worth more than its carrying cost.

The identity-bound digital payment wallet remains strategically aligned with the platform's payment and identity capabilities and its market uncertainty is still unresolved, so retaining the option is justified.
The NFC tag authenticator is a peripheral hardware product with higher ongoing costs and weaker fit with the software platform, so the option has lost value relative to reallocating resources.
The secure payment and wallet framework is central to the firm's secure ecosystem direction and likely still has unresolved upside, so maintaining the option is valuable.
As the flagship platform for multi-service apps, it embodies the firm's strategic direction and the option value of future investment remains high despite its costs.
The application shielding security library complements the core security offering at low marginal cost and its market uncertainty has not fully resolved, so the option is worth keeping.
